## Reviewer fixups (from `epm:reviewer-verdict v1` CONCERNS)

**1. H2 p-value and title qualification.** H2 (behavioral invariance) was pre-registered as "range ≤ 15pp AND p > 0.10". The range passes (8.0pp ≤ 15pp) but the permutation test rejects invariance (p = 0.003). Behavioral leakage DOES vary significantly across conditions. Title updated from "induction-persona-invariant" to "**geometrically** induction-persona-invariant" to make clear the invariance claim is about geometry (M1/M2), not behavior.

**2. Hero figure URL.** Pin to commit: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/superkaiba/explore-persona-space/3f71ce1/figures/issue_205/hero_issue205.png`

**3. 76% → 77%.** Benign-SFT M1 delta (+0.073) is 77.4% of the mean EM delta (+0.094), not 76%.

**4. Sample outputs.** This experiment's primary outputs are numerical (cosine similarities, marker rates), not text completions. Raw completions for the behavioral eval are in `eval_results/issue_205/E{0-4}_*/raw_completions.json` on the `issue-205` branch but are not reproduced in the clean-result body due to length. Reference: branch `issue-205` at `3f71ce1`.
